objections.about: The customer named the Creator plan and a 350 MB file. The reply only says the file must fit the plan's upload limit. It doesn't say whether 350 MB fits, and the cited sections give no Creator limit, so the customer can't tell if the file will upload.

The section says the file must be shared as "Anyone with the link" as Viewer for the direct URL to work. The reply leaves this out, and a wrong sharing setting could also stop the file from downloading.

The section says Blotato already converts Drive share links to the direct format, and the warning page can still appear. Step 3 tells the customer to swap the link as if they hadn't been through this, which doesn't fit someone who says Blotato keeps hitting the warning.
